    Character pack contract

    The manifest, persona and mapping schema

    This page has not been translated yet, so it is shown in Chinese.

    Freeze list for a single character pack. Pack authors replace content; clip / action / file names stay stable unless the contract bumps.

    The official character is an ordinary pack, characters/nomi: with no CHARACTER_PACK the build ships it, through the same loading path as any third-party pack.

    Third-party skinning steps: REPLACING.md.

    #Source of truth

    The contract lives in the @nomi-ai/character-contract package:

    FileContent
    contract.jsonMachine-readable contract (modes, clip / action ids, hitbox ids, semantic vocabulary, file names)
    voice-ids.jsonStable voice clip ids ⇄ legacy i18n keys
    src/schemas.tszod schemas + types for manifest.json, persona.json, mapping.json, locales/*.json
    validatePack() / validatePackDir() (/node)Structured errors / warnings + normalized pack
    migrate*()Pure migrations (skirt → hem, legacy voice keys, legacy copy/ / persona/ / layout/ files)

    Packs contain data only — no code. Engines are app-side plugins selected by assets.mode.

    #Pack layout

    my-character.pack/
  manifest.json        id, contractVersion, assets.mode, capabilities, layout
  persona.json         displayName, shortName?, pronoun?, systemPromptIdentity, addressUser?, greetings[], tips?
  mapping.json         semantic emotion / activity / gesture → engine resource ids (optional)
  locales/zh.json      character copy: lines, wakePhrase, persona overrides
  locales/en.json
  rive/ sprite/ static/
  voice/<locale>/manifest.json + {id}.mp3
  onboarding/{welcome,profile,provider,privacy}.webp
  CREDITS.md / LICENSE

    manifest.credits ({ author, license, source }, optional) feeds the bundled model list and the licence check; the official pack must carry an allow-listed licence.

    #manifest.json

    FieldRequiredNotes
    schemayes1
    idyeslowercase letters, digits, -, _ (≤ 64)
    contractVersionyes\*integer; packs newer than the app's CHARACTER_CONTRACT_VERSION are rejected
    assets.modeyes\*rive (default) / sprite / static
    assets.*norelative paths inside the pack (rive, sprite, static, voice, onboarding)
    capabilitiesnoriveMotions, spriteActions, expressions, voiceClipIds, lipSync, blink; runtime degrades
    layout.windowno{ width, height } in px
    layout.hitboxesno{ head | face | body | hand | hem: { top, bottom, left, right } }, ratios of the box
    layout.bubbleAnchorno{ x, y }, ratios of the box
    riveno{ artboard, stateMachine } overrides
    catalognomodel-list entry: displayName, description, author, tags, version, lastUpdated

    \* Filled in by migration for legacy packs: contractVersion from engines.nomiPack (else 1), top-level mode moves to assets.mode, layout/hitboxes.json ({ regions, bubbleAnchor }) merges into manifest.layout.

    #persona.json

    The single source of the character's identity (system prompt identity, greetings). Product name / appId stay in the host brand and are never taken from the pack.

    {
  "displayName": "Nomi·诺米",
  "shortName": "Nomi",
  "pronoun": "她",
  "systemPromptIdentity": "你是 Nomi（诺米），住在用户桌面上的 AI 伙伴。",
  "addressUser": "你",
  "greetings": ["你好呀，今天想聊点什么？"],
  "tips": ["记得多喝水。"]
}

    displayName, systemPromptIdentity and greetings are required (greetings may be empty — validation warns). displayName is the full name, used where the UI first names the character (「你好，我是 Nomi·诺米」); shortName (optional, defaults to displayName) is used for later mentions (「显示 Nomi」「Nomi 大小」). A locale override that sets displayName without shortName uses that displayName as its short name too. Per-language overrides go in locales/<lang>.json → persona. pronoun (optional) is how the UI refers to the character in a sentence (「点她的『AI 对话』」, "click her “AI chat”"). Give it per language — Chinese in persona.json, English in locales/en.json → persona.pronoun as the subject form (she / he / it / they; the UI derives her / him / its / their). A language without its own value gets the neutral 「它」/ it; the Chinese value is never reused for English. The official pack uses 「她」/ she. Legacy packs without persona.json are migrated from copy/<lang>.json and persona/system-prompt.md (first non-empty line), with a warning.

    #mapping.json

    AI and character only exchange semantic events (emotion(name, weight), activity(name), gesture(name)); the pack maps them to its own resources. emotions point at expressions, activities and gestures at motions. Values are one resource id or a list (runtime picks one). Names outside the vocabulary and names the pack does not map are ignored. A pack without mapping.json gets the engine default mapping (the same as the official pack, characters/nomi/mapping.json); a pack with one gets exactly what it maps.

    {
  "emotions": { "happy": "smile_02", "sad": ["tears", "sigh"] },
  "activities": { "thinking": "think", "toolRunning": "typing_loop" },
  "gestures": { "wave": "wave", "thumbsUp": "thumbs_up" }
}

    Vocabulary (contract.json → mapping, typed as SEMANTIC_* in @nomi-ai/character-contract):

    SectionNames
    emotionsneutral happy sad angry surprised relaxed shy confused sleepy
    activitiesidle thinking toolRunning (idle ends the held pose and needs no mapping)
    gestureswave greet nod shakeHead bow salute pray okHand think explain eureka puzzled listen lookAround lookLeftRight peek heart blowKiss shy coverFace apologize surprise startle sigh smug aggrieved tears angry coldSweat daze cheer thumbsUp peace celebrate clap hop wink tongue cute reachOut work yawn stretch goodnight hum random

    random as a target is reserved for the engine (pick a random gesture). Unknown names and targets not declared in capabilities (expressions for emotions, riveMotions / spriteActions for the rest) produce warnings, not errors.

    #locales/

    Character copy (lines, prompts, voice subtitles) belongs to the pack, not the app's global i18n catalog. Primary locale zh; zh and en are both recommended.

    {
  "persona": { "displayName": "Nomi", "systemPromptIdentity": "You are Nomi, …" },
  "wakePhrase": "Hi, Nomi",
  "lines": { "greet-hello": "Hi, I'm Nomi!", "tip-ask-me-anything": "Ask me anything." }
}

    lines keys are stable voice clip ids (legacy i18n keys resolve via voice-ids.json). The mascot's tips and greetings (packages/renderer/src/mascot/tips.ts lists which ids it uses) are read from here; a pack without a line stays silent there instead of falling back to another character. pnpm check:i18n checks that every pack under characters/ has the same lines (and persona identity fields) in zh and en. At run time lines fall back to the primary locale. Validation warns when a non-primary locale misses keys present in zh. Legacy copy/<lang>.json (displayName, wakePhrase, systemPromptIdentity) is migrated with a warning.

    #Modes

    manifest.assets.modeRequired assetsNotes
    rive (default)rive/character.rivPrimary path; sprite strongly recommended as fallback
    spritesprite/ layered rigMay be primary or fallback
    staticstatic/character.webp (or png)No .riv, no 43 actions required

    #Rive

    FieldDefault (Nomi)Override
    ArtboardNomi-fullmanifest.rive.artboard
    State machineNomiFullmanifest.rive.stateMachine
    Filerive/character.rivmanifest.assets.rive

    Native motion clip names: see contract.json → rive.nativeMotions. Missing clips may be listed under manifest.capabilities.riveMotions omissions; runtime skips unknown ids.

    #Sprite (43 actions)

    When sprite is provided (or mode is sprite), action ids in contract.json → sprite.actionIds must exist (or be declared missing).

    #Voice

    Clip ids are stable name-agnostic ids (see voice-ids.json). Manifest entries use id + i18nKey; file name = {id}.mp3. Legacy i18n-key aliases resolve for one release (resolveVoiceClipId() / contract.voice.legacyKeyAlias).

    Required locale for official pack: zh (see voice.requiredClipIds; validatePack(…, { requireCompleteVoice: true })).

    #Onboarding

    Four files under pack onboarding/:

    • welcome.webp
    • profile.webp
    • provider.webp
    • privacy.webp

    #Hitboxes

    Ids: head / face / body / hand / hem (lower garment; formerly skirt). Declared in manifest.layout.hitboxes (ratios of the character box) + optional layout.bubbleAnchor. Without hitboxes the renderer classifies touches with its geometry heuristic (the official characters/nomi pack declares none). Legacy layout/hitboxes.json is still read and merged; packs that still ship skirt are normalized to hem on load (migrateHitboxIds()).

    #Remote assets

    assets.remote lists asset kinds that are not shipped with the app and are downloaded on demand (currently "rive"). A declared remote asset may be missing from the pack directory; the normalized pack reports it in assets.remote.

    #Loading

    Build time: the renderer / ai-chat Vite builds read the selected pack (CHARACTER_PACK, default characters/nomi) and emit it as dist/character/… (scripts/character/vite-plugin.mjs). Nothing in the source tree is overwritten.

    Run time (CharacterPackService): userData/character-pack → resources/character-pack → the built-in pack (resources/renderer/character when packaged; the repository pack in development). Every candidate goes through validatePack; invalid packs are skipped (logged). Overlays are validated with lenient: true so packs that loaded on 2.0.5 still load: only what 2.0.5 required (manifest schema: 1, a non-empty string id, a known mode, onboarding art, the mode's main asset) rejects the pack. The non-structural checks in NON_STRUCTURAL_ISSUES (rive file size, missing fallback assets, voice manifests), field-level manifest problems (an id outside [a-z0-9_-], kept as written; unknown hitbox ids and invalid regions, dropped; other invalid optional fields, dropped) and invalid persona.json / mapping.json / locales/*.json (ignored) only warn. Built-in packs and character:check stay strict. Overlay assets are served via character-pack://pack/…; the views ask character-pack:get-active, whose snapshot also carries the pack's locales lines. See REPLACING.md.

    #Out of pack

    appId, product name, update channel, UI theme tokens, UI copy (global i18n catalog), character store / multi-character switch UI / pack store. (Custom protocol character-pack:// is in-pack for Scheme B assets only.)

    #Attribution

    Ship CREDITS.md / LICENSE* inside the pack; they travel with it into the build output. In-repository packs are covered by assets-licenses.json (pnpm check:licenses).
